faq.q: Can you buy the Dobot Atom?
faq.a: Yes. Dobot sells it on quote, and resellers such as Dobot.nu and RobotShop list Atom configurations with prices.

faq.q: How much does the Dobot Atom cost?
faq.a: The launch price was reported as US$27,500 in March 2025. Current reseller prices are higher: EUR 85,999 for the Atom Max at Dobot.nu and $100,765-$136,825 for Atom Max research setups at RobotShop.
Dobot says the Atom entered mass production and delivered its first batch at a launch event in Nagoya, Japan, on June 27, 2025.
A compact data-collection version, about 650 mm tall and 20 kg, with two 7-DoF arms. It is much cheaper than the full-size Atom Max.

notes: The $27,500 figure is a launch/pre-order report, not a current list price. The cheapest listing (Atom D) is a compact data-collection robot, not the full-size biped.
